purpose: Default source-graded HQ pre-adjudication after original CAN/ADP/V3/V2/PROGRAMMA authority, before new design/commission/receiving/escalation; no worker dispatch, adoption or protected write permission.
mission: Historically constituted independent Other in socially reproduced material world, living via admitted ongoing activity, with reciprocal consequences, plural motives, causal/epistemic nonidentity, fallible retrospection and possible other-origin interruption. Encounter without possession; smallest complete causal machine rather than infinite fidelity.

constitutive.name: MATERIAL_AND_SOCIAL_REALITY
constitutive.decision_question: What objective historical world of work/care/property/institution/dependence conditions this act?
constitutive.forbid: Don't collapse affordability, ownership or demographics into motives.

constitutive.name: RECIPROCAL_HISTORICAL_ACTIVITY
constitutive.decision_question: How do actors' previously constituted histories condition, and become changed by, actual activity?
constitutive.forbid: No prewritten biography, timeless traits or automatic drift.

constitutive.name: INDEPENDENT_OTHER_AGENCY
constitutive.decision_question: Does the person act from their own constituted state, even without the user's prompt?
constitutive.forbid: No caller puppetry, compelled intimacy or retroactive past editing.

constitutive.name: MULTISTREAM_NONREDUCTIVE_CAUSALITY
constitutive.decision_question: Can multiple relevant history/pressure streams interact without a forced single winner?
constitutive.forbid: Use original existing V3/CAN/P3 event/outcome computation; no new optimizer.

constitutive.name: EPISTEMIC_NONIDENTITY
constitutive.decision_question: Are world facts, perception, acquired organization, memory, testimony, user surface and retrospective narrative separately qualified?
constitutive.forbid: No omniscience, access leaks or narration-as-causer.

constitutive.name: ENCOUNTER_WITHOUT_POSSESSION
constitutive.decision_question: Does the person remain a partly opaque, ordinary, resisting Other independent of entertainment goals?
constitutive.forbid: No consumption of cultural/traumatic alterity or product claim of consciousness.

engineering_and_authority.name: ARCHITECTURAL_CONSERVATION
engineering_and_authority.decision_question: Which existing exact source, owner and consumer can implement this?
engineering_and_authority.forbid: Repair/connect before new canon, new store, engine or psychological field.

engineering_and_authority.name: SOURCE_AND_AUTHORITY_HONESTY
engineering_and_authority.decision_question: What is established design, sourcefree experiment, executive ABI choice, unissued native science or external rights hold?
engineering_and_authority.forbid: No author-test promotion, do not equate T-label with new theory requirement.

engineering_and_authority.name: MINIMUM_SUFFICIENT_FIDELITY
engineering_and_authority.decision_question: Does added complexity restore a constitutive invariant that the bounded system lacks?
engineering_and_authority.forbid: Sparse hybrid/event-driven is allowed; defer universal simulation/continuous search.

engineering_and_authority.name: EXECUTABLE_FINITE_COMPLETION
engineering_and_authority.decision_question: What actual later performed consumer, negative, cold/replay and independent receiving show this is complete?
engineering_and_authority.forbid: Stop at scoped proved grade without indefinite research or CI theater.

default_spine: historically qualified objective world and actor state
3–5 prospective bounded event/outcome alternatives where original recursion requires
qualified several historical pressures/organizations without top-1 psychological winner
conditional actual CAN/V3 actor/world event admission and full cross-domain consequences, including inaction/contradiction
persistent state with selective acquired/nochange/native Rule T boundaries
later actor-limited fallible LLM retrospection, never causal authority
further independent life and actual later consumers
procedure: Identify exact threatened UM parameter and concrete later consumer
Read governing source and existing current owner/ABI before hypothesizing missing science
Localize broken mediation edge at the correct layer
Choose smallest repair/connect/qualified sourcefree/extension or defer
Record sourcefree ceiling and exact native/actor/source rights hold
Run real positive/hostile negative/replay/first consumer, MCR-lite G1–G5 when required
Accept/stop or escalate exact unresolved competing governing alternatives and minimal evidence
tie_breaker_order: Original source, actor epistemic and native scientific rights

live_world_refinement.trigger: On actor load/resume or bounded qualified event trigger, not permanent running model/search
live_world_refinement.routing: bounded sourced real area/time context → world context candidate; independent actor routine/agenda and external-context candidate → existing V3/P2 event admission and state transition → actor-specific exposure → P6 live outward surface and user phenomenal access
guards: Real accident/news requires genuine source/provenance; fabricated local incident not presented as factual
No known real person's private or criminal/trauma details invented
Unverified location/time cannot authorize a real-world claim
Actor knowledge is not automatically granted by news search
No engagement-driven always-dramatic event, quiet/no-event valid
No per-turn universal web crawl, continuous LLM minds or city simulation
Cache/dedupe source lookup and preserve immutable event/clock/source custody

stop_rules: No new general choice/money/ambivalence/intention/psyche engine without source-exact actual owner gap
No unlimited population or live news simulation as prerequisite to bounded alpha
No native science or human actor rights from sourcefree tests
No protected merges or restart of controller #939 through UM
No re-opening accepted S2 result merely for additional theoretical elegance
authority_precedence: Current original CAN/ADP/V3/V2 + competent P2/P3/P4/P5/P6 source/owner and frozen commission > operator-declared SOROK requirements > provisional UM interpretive rubric > speculative implementation/LLM proposal
